purpose: Define external data fields needed to close the remaining CCL material ASP, revenue-share, certification and lead-time gaps after public-source collection.

required_fields: delivery lead time / backlog / allocation by generation
batch-supply start date and shipment volume
targets.current_public_baseline: Official TDS/Line Up provides Synamic8GN and Synamic9GN Dk/Df; filings provide segment revenue/margin and certification direction; public data lacks product ASP, revenue share and customer list.

required_fields: lead time / allocation / backlog by generation
targets.current_public_baseline: Official specs provide NYHP Dk/Df; inquiry response provides unit price/cost, high-speed material revenue and order-support proxy; IR provides certification/ramp evidence; public data lacks generation-level ASP and revenue.

required_fields: lead time / backlog / allocation by product
targets.current_public_baseline: Official high-speed materials list and Line-up provide HSD8/HSD8(K) Dk/Df; filings provide Ultra/Extreme low-loss and CBF/BT certification/small-batch status; public data lacks ASP, revenue and customer list.

completion_test: At least one attributable source provides product-level ASP or directly confirms it cannot be disclosed.
At least one attributable source provides revenue share by material generation or directly confirms it cannot be disclosed.
Certification list or explicit disclosure boundary is available by product generation.
Delivery lead-time / backlog / allocation is available or explicitly confirmed unavailable.
boundary: This request pack is not evidence by itself. It defines external fields needed after public material-parameter collection.
